description: Choose between formal or casual greeting style

variants.command: set -e; echo 'Good day, esteemed user. Welcome to our application.' > hello.txt; git add hello.txt; git commit -m 'Formal greeting experiment'; echo 'Current branch:'; git branch --show-current; echo 'hello.txt:'; cat hello.txt

set -e; echo 'Hey there! Welcome to the app!' > hello.txt; git add hello.txt; git commit -m 'Casual greeting experiment'; echo 'Current branch:'; git branch --show-current; echo 'hello.txt:'; cat hello.txt
